notes.title: Version 1.5.10
notes.content: [p]- There's now a fourth "this is important" marker for Murder Mystery[/p][p]- Murder Mystery now marks all cards eligible for a "weapon/killer is in slot X" hint with a little icon indicating the hint's number[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.9
notes.content: [p]​- Time Travel Solitaire allows undoing again​[/p][p]- Added the ability to choose a different music track when playing a solitaire[/p][p]- Added a setting to pause audio when the game loses focus (defaults to being off)[/p][p]- Made Solitairdle mark only as many letter cards as yellow as there are those letters in the correct word​[/p][p]- Made previous guesses more visible in Solitairdle[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.8
notes.content: [p]- You can hold middle mouse button or D to spread cards temporarily to more easily see what's in each stack[/p][p]- Fixed Double-sided Solitaire having bugs with the new card highlighting feature[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629853/8def512a4c93b30c56564025be27f086b6458f07.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.7
notes.content: [p]​- Added an effect that highlights where you can place cards you're holding (can be disabled in the settings)[/p][p]- Hovering over the letter icons in Solitairdle highlights where all the cards of that letter are in the card stacks[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629853/ff27d982e9ea1700f692c34c0547114ecef29959.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.6
notes.content: [p]​- Added the ability to undo while holding cards[/p][p]- Right-clicking while holding cards puts them back where they were picked up from (can't be done in Time Travel Solitaire or Tabula Rasa Solitaire)[/p][p]- Fixed a bug in the stacking rules in Uneven Solitaire[/p][p]- Added the ability to disable visual win streak indicators in settings[/p][p]- Added a new achievement for winning a solitaire without undoing at all[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.5
notes.content: [p]​- Yet more fixes to Fork Solitaire, let's see if it works now[/p][p]- Added an option in the settings to disallow pixel stretching in fullscreen mode. This might look a bit silly on some monitors due to the margins, but oh well[/p][p]- Clarified Murder Mystery rules to indicate that the 4 incorrect accounts are always 2 for weapon, 2 for killer[/p][p]- Adjusted the way slots lock up in Binary & Single-card Solitaire to make them slightly harder[/p][p]- Adjusted the rules of Circuit Solitaire to make it less trivial[/p][p]- Adjusted Double-sided Solitaire card art further[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.4
notes.content: [p]​- Further fixes to Fork Solitaire; maybe it actually doesn't crash anymore?[/p][p]- Adjusted Double-sided Solitaire card art to make the numbers more visible[/p][p]- Made pressing Escape give the exit prompt instead of directly exiting if the prompting setting is set[/p][p]- Made sure that "get X total wins" achievements don't stop working if they fail to be granted at the exact win count indicated[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.3e
notes.content: [p]- Added a button to pick a random solitaire in the main menu[/p][p]​- Guaranteed that the top cards in each stack are a different suit from each other in Ferret Rabbit Carrot[/p][p]- Fixed a crash on picking up all cards in a stack in Fork Solitaire (other crashes remain)[/p][p]- Adjusted the 10-cards in Fork Solitaire to make them easier to read[/p][p]- Tried to fix a crash in Tear Solitaire[/p][p]- Adjusted visuals in Hanoi Solitaire to make it clearer when you're holding cards[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.3b
notes.content: [p]- Fixed being able to keep playing after game overing in Ferret Rabbit Carrot[/p][p]​- Another undo-related bug in Fork Solitaire squashed[/p][p]- Adjusted wording in Council of Secrets a bit[/p][p]- Fixed hovering over cards not working right in Fork Solitaire[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.3
notes.content: [p]- Added a prompt checking if you want to restart or exit a solitaire; you can turn it off in the settings. It won't trigger when using R or Escape to do those actions[/p][p]- Returned undoing to Fork Solitaire[/p][p]- Tried to fix crashing & other issues in Fork Solitaire - please report if/when you encounter issues[/p][p]- Fixed being able to place cards outside of the playfield in 52-card Solitaire[/p][p]- Fixed an issue in Tap Solitaire that could cause you to "lose" one tap permanently[/p][p]- Fixed a visual issue when playing another Solitairdle after winning one[/p][p]- Fixed being able to swap with the power-generator King cards in Circuit Solitaire[/p][p]- Fixed being able to bypass stack movement rules in Hanoi Solitaire[/p][p]- Adjusted some info screens to make their visuals not look janky in fullscreen mode[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.2
notes.content: [p]- Fixed an autostacking & undo -related issue in Babataire[/p][p]- Further fixes to card z-layering in Single-Stack Solitaire[/p][p]- Fixed a typo in Single-Stack Solitaire's rules text[/p][p]- Clarified Babataire rules text a tad[/p][p]- Single-Stack Solitaire's achievement should work again[/p][p]- Fixed Tear Solitaire crashing when trying for an extra challenge[/p][p]- Fixed 2 achievement having the same name as another achievement[/p][p]- Fixed Murder Mystery's extra challenge not granting the achievement[/p][p]- Adjusted Double-sided Solitaire to make the cards a bit easier to read when stacked[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5.1
notes.content: [p](Mac version is now up to date with the others)[/p][p]- Temporarily disabled undoing on Fork Solitaire and Time Travel Solitaire until those are fixed[/p][p]- Added a margin to all solitaires when playing fullscreen to fix visual bugs[/p][p]- Clarified rules of Solartaire (empty planet slots can be used from any orbit)[/p][p]- Fixed Lock-and-Key solitaire not letting you put a card back after swapping it back and forth[/p][p]- Fixed Council of Secrets not having a setting without Roman numerals[/p][p]- Fixed (hopefully actually this time) Royal Flush Solitaire deleting your streak when restarting after a win[/p][p]- Tried to address multiple bugs related to cards going behind other cards incorrectly[/p][p]- Fixed an undo issue in 52-card Solitaire[/p][p]- Fixed being unable to place a transmuted card back into its slot (in cases where it hadn't been placed elsewhere first)[/p][p]- Added the ability to recombine torn cards in Tear Solitaire if the torn half hasn't been placed elsewhere yet[/p][p]- Fixed Murder Solitaire claiming it can be played with a standard deck[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
[p]​First proper patch! I fixed some crashes earlier without posting patchnotes, though.[/p][p]- Fixed Binary Solitaire and Single-card Solitaire not undoing properly when you finish a stack
- Fixed Eldritch Invasion not undoing properly when you defeat a monster
- Fixed(?) Babataire being able to make a card not respect rules changes after undoing
- Fixed Royal Flush Solitaire not keeping your streak if you continue after a win and then restart
- Fixed Single-stack Solitaire's completion achievement not triggering
- Fixed(?) card visual layering bugs in Single-stack Solitaire - this change might cause bugs elsewhere, so do report it if you see anything unusual
- Adjusted the music choice in Double-sided Solitaire and Lock-and-Key Solitaire[/p][p]Outstanding issues:
- The game has a lot of graphical glitches related to fullscreen mode
- Fork solitaire bugs out really bad if you break a fork when one of the branches has a sub-fork
- Time Travel Solitaire has undo bugs
- Lock-and-Key Solitaire fails to let you take back a move if you've swapped cards around[/p]

notes.title: Baba Is You dev's wacky card game A Solitaire Mystery is about to get bigger
notes.content:
The developer of hit indie game Baba Its You is finally about to bring another one of their projects to Steam, while also making it better than ever. Arvi 'Hempuli' Teikari's A Solitaire Mystery is an eccentric twist on the card game you know, and perfect if you've got a Balatro-shaped hole in your heart right now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Release on July 9th!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="mXShZRfkyJo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A Solitaire Mystery will be releasing on Wednesday, July 9th! The game will be available on PC, Mac & Linux, and will feature a total of 30 solitaires. The price of the game will be USD $10.[/p][p]Music by Hazelstorm: [url="https://hazelstorm.bandcamp.com/album/a-solitaire-mystery-ost"]https://hazelstorm.bandcamp.com/album/a-solitaire-mystery-ost[/url][/p]
